The Commerce Branch is preparing to buy out the Akimichi grain contracts entirely.
A 'Ghost of the Crow' was seen moving through the Uchiha District during the last Ley-line tremor.
The Commerce Uchiha are rumored to possess a 'Silent Library' of secrets that even the Hokage cannot access.
A 'Ghost' slaughtered a Cloud team at the North Gate with no Sharingan active.
The Commerce Uchiha are planning to buy the Hokage Rock to build a mall.
The 'Merchant Scion' is actually a secret pupil of the Sannin.
A 'Red Cloud' has been sighted near the Land of Fire borders, moving with unnatural speed.
A 'Ghost of the Star' is moving through the border, un-writing Cloud ambushes with a word.
The Uchiha Commerce Branch is secretly hoarding 70% of the village's tactical-silk.
A 'Ghost of the Star' was seen walking through the North Gate sensors without a single ping.
The 'Merchant Scion' is actually an Ocular Genius who corrects Jonin-tier Chidori math.
A high-tier 'Logic Error' in the southern ley-lines is causing sensory equipment to fail.
The 'Merchant Prince' is rumored to have a heart of ice that even the Amaterasu cannot melt.
The 'Merchant Scion' is being targeted by the Sound and Akatsuki because of a 'forbidden treasure' in his family's vaults.
The 'Late Bloomer' of the Commerce District single-handedly held a border-pass against the Red Cloud.
The 'Late Bloomer' from the Commerce Branch stood his ground against the Akatsuki to save the Shadow Hokage's daughter.
The Uchiha Commerce Branch is preparing to buy out the entire Akimichi chip-distribution network.
The 'Merchant Prince' carries a gear-set that can delete S-rank jutsu.
The 'Merchant Scion' is actually a failed clone of the original Itachi created by Orochimaru.
The Hidden Stone is preparing a 'World-Eater' weapon at the border.
The 'Merchant Prince' of the Uchiha is a high-tier decoy for an Ohtsutsuki weapon.
The 'Merchant Prince' is actually a reincarnation of the clan's greatest tragedy.
The Merchant Scion is a biological ghost of the original Itachi.
The Land of Earth has officially declared a 'Sanctions Audit' against Konoha iron.
